definitions.explanation: The activity of catching fish, typically with a rod and line. A popular recreational activity in Japan.
The money returned when you pay more than the price. Written as お{釣|つ}り in this meaning.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{釣|つ}りに{行|い}きます。
{海|うみ}{釣|づ}りと{川|かわ}{釣|づ}り、どちらが{好|す}きですか。
examples.english: Do you prefer sea fishing or river fishing?
examples.notes: Note: 釣り becomes づり in compounds

examples.japanese: お{釣|つ}りはいりません。

notes:
USAGE: {釣|つ}り has two distinct meanings: (1) fishing and (2) change (money). The context usually makes the meaning clear.

FISHING-RELATED WORDS:
・{釣|つ}りをする (to go fishing)
・{海|うみ}{釣|づ}り (sea fishing)
・{川|かわ}{釣|づ}り (river fishing)
・{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお} (fishing rod)
・{釣|つ}り{針|ばり} (fishhook)
・{釣|つ}り{人|びと} (angler, fisherman)
・{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり} (fishing pond)

MONEY-RELATED:
・お{釣|つ}り (change - always with お)
・お{釣|つ}りをもらう (to receive change)

Note: The verb form {釣|つ}る means both 'to fish' and 'to lure/entice'.
